intro.data: Your tray holds Encode and three decoders that all fit the type B→A, but only one truly undoes Encode and returns the exact original file. The other two return something else. Bring Encode and the genuine inverse onto the board and wire them, leaving the other two decoders in the tray.
intro.alchemy: Your tray holds Grind and three recasts that all fit B→A, but only one truly undoes Grind. The others return something else. Bring Grind and the genuine inverse onto the board and wire them, leaving the other two recasts in the tray.
intro.spellcraft: Your tray holds Etch and three readings that all fit B→A, but only one truly undoes Etch. The others return something else. Bring Etch and the genuine inverse onto the board and wire them, leaving the other two readings in the tray.
intro.abstract: Three candidates fit B→A; only one makes the round trip return the original. Here values are concrete: Encode sends 3 ↦ 3●, and the three candidates send 3● ↦ 3, 3● ↦ 5, and 3● ↦ 7 — only the first brings 3 back. Bring Encode and the genuine inverse from the tray and wire them, leaving the other two behind.

goal.data: Bring Encode and a decoder from the tray and wire them so it returns the exact original file.
goal.alchemy: Bring Grind and a recast from the tray and wire them so it returns the exact bar.
goal.spellcraft: Bring Etch and a reading from the tray and wire them so it returns the exact sigil.
goal.abstract: Bring Encode and the B→A morphism that sends 3● ↦ 3 from the tray and wire them so the round trip returns the original 3, leaving the other two in the tray.

description.data: packs the data into a blob
description.spellcraft: etches the spark into a glyph

afterSuccess.data: Only Decode returned the exact original — the other two were the right type but lost information. Type narrows the field; behavior decides which is the inverse.
afterSuccess.alchemy: Only Recast returned the exact bar — the others lost something. Type narrows the field; behavior decides the inverse.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: Only Read returned the exact sigil — the others lost something. Type narrows the field; behavior decides the inverse.
afterSuccess.abstract: Only the genuine inverse restored the original; the type-valid look-alikes did not.

reveal.summary: Many morphisms can share the inverse's type, but only one actually inverts — the one whose round trip is the identity on values.
reveal.moreFormal: The inverse, when it exists, is unique. Being B → A is necessary but far from sufficient.
reveal.programmerAnalogy: Several B→A functions type-check; only the true inverse round-trips.
